sql:
WITH RECURSIVE entity_rollup AS (
    SELECT EntityKey AS LeafEntityKey, EntityKey AS AncestorEntityKey, ParentEntityKey
    FROM retail.DimEntity
    UNION ALL
    SELECT er.LeafEntityKey, toInt32(e.EntityKey) AS AncestorEntityKey, e.ParentEntityKey
    FROM entity_rollup er
    JOIN retail.DimEntity e ON toInt32(er.ParentEntityKey) = e.EntityKey
    WHERE er.ParentEntityKey IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    de.EntityKey,
    de.EntityName,
    de.EntityType,
    sum(f.SalesAmount) AS TotalSalesAmount,
    sum(f.SalesQuantity) AS TotalSalesQuantity,
    sum(f.SalesAmount) - sum(f.TotalCost) AS GrossMargin
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimStore s ON s.StoreKey = f.StoreKey
JOIN entity_rollup er ON er.LeafEntityKey = toInt32(s.EntityKey)
JOIN retail.DimEntity de ON de.EntityKey = er.AncestorEntityKey
GROUP BY de.EntityKey, de.EntityName, de.EntityType
ORDER BY TotalSalesAmount DESC
